title: Miscellaneous
markdown:
This section includes the APIs to retrieve IOC types, country details, source types, sources, and collections of the sources.

### Supported SDO Types

Intel Exchange supports the following SDO types in Threat Data:

  
    Vulnerability
    vulnerability
  
  
    Malware
    malware
  
  
    Campaign
    campaign
  
  
    Threat Actor
    threat-actor
  
  
    Intrusion Set
    intrusion-set
  
  
    Attack Pattern
    attack-pattern
  
  
    Incident
    incident
  
  
    Course of Action
    course-of-action
  
  
    Identity
    identity
  
  
    Tool
    tool
  
  
    Infrastructure
    infrastructure
  
  
    Location
    location
  
  
    Malware Analysis
    malware-analysis
  
  
    Custom Objects
    custom-object
  
  
    Indicator
    indicator
